display_name: 完整CRIC+DURA跨配置与匹配监督/PL对比设计
description: Same authorized CRIC+DURA matrix; source smoke no_grad compatibility recovery, reusing completed seventeen-contract source data. No scientific recipe changes.
authorization: 用户2026-10-21指定CRIC+DURA完整方法，与当前对比配置比较，并详细设计机制时延与消融；五源数量扫点不新跑。

code.commit: Resolved at immutable release from current pushed Git HEAD
code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python3.10/Torch2.1; FP32 TF32off; CPU2

data.physical_ids_ref: Existing source/target data-contract records; no IQ or truth opened for this design/aggregation
data.label_map_ref: Existing native source-contract metadata; no posthoc head fitting
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing VALIDATED_ONCE handles; new contracts bound before actual launch

permissions.regime: Source-only training planned; target frozen inference only
permissions.query_use: F source worker has no target/test/truth input. Evaluation released as separate stage after matching G; all readouts predicted before independent truth-last.
permissions.claim_scope: Previously exposed engineering benchmark; not independent blind or in-orbit validation

checkpoint.initialization: 150 new main F from scratch; 3 exact-contract F0 native readouts reused
sources: F0 reuse only; new model initialization scratch
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing exact-contract F0 evidence; every new F/G/teacher must match its own contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: F source receives only its own source cache/role contract; no teacher or different-contract checkpoint.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Frozen existing F0 scores; prospective fixed-final source schedule, no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0..7, one own/card, at most 2 total compute apps/card, free>=12000MiB. User explicitly permits joining spare VRAM; preserve all healthy tasks. Timing exclusive GPU.
execution.stop_rule: No performance stopping. Two same-fingerprint source technical failures stop new launches; retain healthy peers and every artifact.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent truth-last after all seven predictions per row
